about.intro: I'm a first-year PhD researcher at LaSTI Lab, working on artificial intelligence and machine learning, and a teaching assistant supporting undergraduate courses. Before research, I trained as a software engineer — that mix still shapes how I work: rigorous about ideas, practical about building things.
about.philosophy: A Berber proverb my family raised me on: be like an onion — it keeps growing in almost any condition, even without soil. That's how I try to learn: in the lab, in the classroom, and in whatever new field pulls my curiosity next.
